name: SG-1 Level Transmitter Drift (Channel B)
description: One of three steam generator level channels drifts slowly upward. The feedwater controller (using the voted signal) begins to underfeed SG-1 while channel disagreement grows. The physical level falls even though one indicator looks high.
briefing: Channel B of the SG-1 level instrument starts drifting at t+20 s. Compare the three channels, identify the faulted one, and take manual control of feedwater before a low-low level trip.
learning_objectives: Instrument failure versus process failure: the tank is not actually full
Median/voting logic and how a single drifting channel skews control
Value of redundant instrumentation and cross-channel checks
